_comment: Source configuration for planner.py. Email patterns are case-insensitive globs tested against BOTH the bare address and the full 'Display Name <address>' header, so a sender can be denied by name when its address is shared (Canvas announcements all come from notifications@instructure.com). Allow is applied first, then deny. No secrets here; CANVAS_ICS_URL lives in .env.

canvas._comment: skip_context_patterns: Canvas courses/homerooms whose items and announcements are ignored (globs on context_name). Course announcements from real courses and the SDSU Graduate Students homeroom are kept.

commands._comment: Mail FROM these addresses to the watcher inbox is treated as planner commands (done/defer/drop/add ...). NOTIFY_EMAIL is always included.
